skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding Basic Concepts in Rural Economy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to recognize and understand basic concepts in rural economy.
Students will be able to explain key concepts and characteristics of rural areas and rural development.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Economic Structure and Structural Change in Rural Economy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to apply knowledge to explain economic structure and structural changes in rural economy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing and Evaluating Rural Economic Development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze and evaluate the development of rural economic sectors such as agriculture, industry, and services.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Infrastructure and Environmental Management in Rural Development
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to analyze infrastructure and environmental management issues in rural development.
Students will develop the ability to independently study and accumulate experience to improve their professional expertise.
Students will demonstrate teamwork and collaboration skills in group presentations and discussions.
